headline: BTS, CORTIS win grand prizes on 2026 MAMA Day 2
sub: BTS take Album of the Year, CORTIS win Song of the Year

points.title: What to know
items: BTS win a grand prize on both nights
CORTIS also take Best Dance Performance (Male Group)
BIGBANG named Music Visionary of the Year
HWASA, ILLIT, TAEYANG, LE SSERAFIM also win

caption:
BTS and CORTIS took home the grand prizes on Day 2 of the 2026 MAMA AWARDS.

At Kyocera Dome Osaka on Nov 21, BTS won Album of the Year for 'ARIRANG', a day after winning Artist of the Year. CORTIS won Song of the Year for 'REDRED' and tearfully said, "We treated every stage as a dream stage."

BIGBANG were named Music Visionary of the Year, and other Day 2 winners include HWASA, ILLIT, TAEYANG and LE SSERAFIM.

📌 Source: Joy News 24, TenAsia (via Korean media)
